messages.author: 82889e926eb5165e
messages.subject: Re: Three variables measured over time
parts:
yes, and you can do this in a variety of ways.
1.  model a growth curve for each variable, and they estimate the relation between the growth factors between each vriable
2.  estimate latent change scores, and estimate the relations between changes over time
3.  estimate a panel model, and estimate the effect that each variable has on each other across time points

I think that option 1 makes more sense, for what I understand of your comments
